notes.title: Hot Fix Registration
notes.notes: Some players reported that registration failed due to not seeing the confirmation pop-up. We have made an update to fix this problem.

notes.title: Language change
notes.notes:
Thank you all for your enthusiasm! Recently, we've received feedback from players mentioning difficulties in setting the game language to Chinese. To assist you, we are providing a step-by-step guide to change the default language in the game. We hope this helps. We will also continue to update and gradually improve the guidance on this aspect.

Feel free to leave comments and suggestions. Thank you!

[b]To change the UI language in any section of the game, if you encounter AI responses in English, you can modify the language to Chinese again by clicking the gear icon on the left side of the game lobby.[/b]

notes.title: Story Crafter DEMO officially debuts at the Steam New Product Festival
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45059969/e22799980af42c4440eb6b5ee063761e6b15bf75.png[/img]
We are honored to inform you that Story Crafter invites you to participate in our AI tabletop RPG game!

Thank you for signing up for beta testing. Recently, we have made significant improvements to the game's content, flow, and visuals. We have also launched four uniquely styled stories for players to explore.

From October 14th to 21st, as part of the Steam Next Fest, players who log in will receive Story Tokens worth $6 USD.

At the same time, we are eager to hear your feedback about our game. Feel free to contact us via email or leave a comment on Steam. We truly appreciate your support of our game!!!

Email: storycrafter.ai@gmail.com
Web version: https://storycrafter.ai/about
